title: 第13章 发现野生精灵虫第14章 魔药收获
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
卖了盐之后，领地里消停了好几天。
佩林每天照常去五个屯转悠。
回来就向罗恩汇报，罗恩听着，发现确实没什么需要自己操心的。
播种完了，围墙修好了，该建的都在建，该长的都在长。
农奴们按部就班干活，卫兵们按部就班操练，佩林把账管得明明白白，迪克那小子挨了鞭子之后也老实了不少。
这么下去，他这个领主天天待在庄园里，倒像个摆设了。
“大人，要不出去转转？”劳恩看出了他的心思。
“领地咱们只粗略跑过一回，好多地方还没踩实。”
罗恩点点头，是该出去走走了。
顺便，也该把巡逻队的事定下来，不能总让卫兵窝在营房里操练，得让他们熟悉领地的地盘。
他让劳恩挑了十五个机灵的卫兵，加上格雷，一共十八个人，备足了干粮和水袋。
第二天清早，一行人骑马出了庄园。
出了农庄范围，地势渐渐起伏，罗恩一行人在荒野中艰难行进，荒野里本就没有路，只能靠着大致方向往前走。
马蹄踩过及膝的荒草，偶尔有野兔从旁边草丛中窜过，引得马匹打个响鼻。
往北走了两个时辰，眼前出现一片杂木林，橡树和松树混在一起，林子里暗沉沉的，没有贸然进去。
队伍沿着树林边缘往西北方向走，脚下渐渐有了坡度。
林子边缘的灌木丛里，有什么东西窸窸窣窣地响了几声，几个灰绿色的影子一闪而过。
是哥布林，没敢出来。
劳恩看了一眼：“这种小东西到处都是，不成气候，但烦人。”
走了约莫一个小时，地势越来越高，视野也开阔起来。

劳恩勒住马，指着远处一道隐约的山梁：
“大人，那边就是茂林岭的地界。领主也是个新开拓的，比咱们早来三个月，还没打过照面。”
罗恩眺望片刻，只看见山梁上稀稀拉拉的树木，没有炊烟，也没有人迹。
“再往北呢？”
“无主之地。”
劳恩指了指更远的方向，“北边荒野上听说有兽人部落活动。所有开拓领的北边都一样，想扩张，只能往北打。”
往回走的路上，经过一片洼地，芦苇长得比人还高。这是罗恩第1次巡视领地的时候遇到的那个洼地。
罗恩的领地着实是不小，可惜现在最紧缺的是人，只能等庄园那边彻底站稳脚跟之后，农奴充足再来开发这些地方。
到时候就派农奴来这边建立农庄，先把地盘占住。
傍晚回庄园时，马背上多了十来只野鸭，路上顺手射的，晚上加餐。
又一日，往西走。
沿着清水河往上游走，河面时宽时窄。
荒野里行走不比大道，有些地方草深及腰，有些地方乱石成堆，马匹走得磕磕绊绊。
走了两个小时，经过一处河滩。劳恩忽然勒住马，翻身下去，蹲在岸边看了半晌。
“大人，这处是浅滩。”他指着河面。
“水流缓，河底是鹅卵石，能蹚水过河。”
罗恩下马走到岸边，顺着劳恩手指的方向看去。对岸的草丛里，有一条被踩出来的小径，直通河边。
“对岸有人经常过的痕迹。”
临水领！！
罗恩盯着那条小径看了半晌。鲍里斯的人，没事往这边踩点做什么？
content_en:
After selling the salt, the territory was quiet for several days.
Perrin went to the five villages as usual every day.
When I got back, I reported to Ron. Ron listened and found that there was really nothing he needed to worry about.
The sowing is finished, the fence is repaired, everything that needs to be built is being built, and everything that needs to grow is growing.
The serfs worked step by step, the guards drilled step by step, Perrin managed the accounts clearly, and Dick became a lot more honest after being whipped.
If this continues, he, the lord, will look like a decoration when he stays in the manor every day.
"Sir, why don't you go out for a walk?" Lawn saw what he was thinking.
"We have only briefly visited the territory once, and there are many places that we haven't stepped into yet."
Ron nodded, it was time to go for a walk.
By the way, the patrol team should also be settled. The guards cannot always be drilled in the barracks. They must be familiar with the territory.
He asked Lawn to choose fifteen smart guards, plus Gray, there were a total of eighteen people, and they had enough dry food and water bags.
Early the next morning, a group of people rode out of the manor.
After leaving the farm, the terrain gradually undulated. Ron and his party were traveling hard in the wilderness. There was no road in the wilderness, so they could only move forward in the general direction.
The horses' hooves stepped on the knee-high grass, and occasionally a hare scurried through the grass nearby, causing the horses to snort.
After walking north for two hours, a forest of mixed woods appeared in front of me. Oaks and pine trees were mixed together. The forest was dark and dark, so I didn't rush in.
The team walked northwest along the edge of the woods, and there was a gradual slope under their feet.
In the bushes at the edge of the forest, something rustled a few times, and several gray-green shadows flashed past.
It was a goblin and he didn't dare to come out.
Lawn took a look and said, "Such little things are everywhere. They are irrelevant but annoying."
After walking for about an hour, the terrain became higher and higher, and the view became wider.
Lawn reined in his horse and pointed to a vague mountain ridge in the distance:
"Sir, that's the boundary of Maolin Ridge over there. The lord is also a newly established one. He came three months earlier than us and has never met us before."
Ron looked for a moment and saw only sparse trees on the mountain ridge, no smoke, and no sign of human beings.
“What about further north?”
"No Man's Land."
Lawn pointed in a further direction, "I heard that there are orc tribes in the northern wilderness. It is the same in the north of all pioneer territories. If you want to expand, you can only fight north."
On the way back, we passed a depression where reeds grew taller than a person. This was the depression that Ron encountered when he inspected the territory for the first time.
Ron's territory is really not small, but unfortunately the most urgent thing now is people. We can only develop these places after the manor has completely established a foothold and there are enough serfs.
When the time comes, serfs will be sent here to build farms and occupy the land first.
When I returned to the manor in the evening, there were more than ten wild ducks on the horse. I shot them on the way. They were added to the meal in the evening.
Another day, heading west.
Walking upstream along the Qingshui River, the river surface is sometimes wide and sometimes narrow.
Walking in the wilderness is no better than a road. In some places, the grass is waist deep, in some places there are piles of rocks, and the horses are stumbling.
After walking for two hours, we passed a river beach. Lao En suddenly reined in his horse, turned over and squatted on the bank for a long time.
"Sir, this is the shallows." He pointed to the river.
"The water flow is slow and the bottom of the river is pebbles, so you can wade across the river."
Ron dismounted and walked to the shore, looking in the direction of Ron's finger. In the grass on the other side, there is a trampled path that leads directly to the river.
"There are traces of someone passing by frequently on the other side."
Near the water! !
Ron stared at the path for a long time. Boris' people, what are you doing here if you have nothing to do?
